ns2:course.label: Video Reporting & Storytelling
ns2:course.description: Introduces field production and principles of field reporting and editing of news video; principles of planning, producing, and editing news stories. Prerequisite: JOUR 210. May not be taken concurrently with JOUR 217. May be taken concurrently with JOUR 317.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: JOUR 210. May not be taken concurrently with JOUR 217. May be taken concurrently with JOUR 317.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Journalism or Agricultural Communications or Ag Ldrship, Ed & Communication major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
